\newcommand{\tiledescriptions}{%
\subsection{Tile descriptions of Fig.~\ref{fig:tiles}}\label{app:tiledesc}
{\scriptsize\setlength{\parskip}{0.6pt}\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}\raggedright
Position = grid page.row.column; chips: \ding{108} public, $\blacktriangle$ gt train-only, $\blacklozenge$ est-probe. Each entry: what the term encodes on the shown state; operator and form (with the hand-set coefficients); source.\par
\smallskip{\bfseries\scshape structure / edges}\par
\texttt{edge.node\_in\_assembly} [1.1.1] \ding{108}: a joint / sensor token attends to the assembly (arm, gripper) it belongs to. edge x bias at act>ctx and ctx>ctx (solid: act nodes, dashed: touch / grip sensors; w=1). Source: public morphology (featurizer).\par
\texttt{edge.same\_assembly} [1.1.2] \ding{108}: a command dim attends to the other dims of its own assembly (here the left arm). edge x bias at dims>dims (g1-dim-rel-v1 channel same\_assembly; w=1). Source: public morphology (bodies.g1\_simple).\par
\texttt{edge.same\_node} [1.1.3] \ding{108}: an action-node query attends to its OWN morphology token (one per actuated joint). edge x bias, w*A[i,j] at act>ctx (arm-rel-v1, w=1 shown). Source: public morphology (featurizer).\par
\texttt{id.same\_assembly} [1.1.4] \ding{108}: soft same-assembly term: a command dim prefers knots of its own assembly (left arm); other assemblies stay readable. same x aug, random 16-d codes for 64 ids (small cross-talk), g=1, dims>knots. Source: public morphology (bodies.g1\_simple).\par
\texttt{id.same\_body} [1.1.5] \ding{108}: tokens denoting the SAME entity (a tracker slot and the task roles bound to it) attend to each other. same x aug: fixed random 16-d unit codes for 64 ids (1 on equal ids, small cross-talk otherwise), g=1. Source: public ids (featurizer pointers).\par
\texttt{id.slot\_handle} [1.1.6] \ding{108}: each scene token carries its public tracker slot address as a learned embedding, so a slot keeps its identity across steps. embed form (unary, no attention term); E learned. Source: public tracker slot ids.\par
\texttt{msg.incidence} [1.2.1] \ding{108}: role and predicate tokens receive a message from the entity they point to (arrows: entity -> role). message form, not a logit term; W learned; control 'serialized' = same facts as hashed text. Source: public task graph + tracker slots.\par
\texttt{route.assembly\_reads} [1.2.2] \ding{108}: system 0 (Psi0 Realizer): a command dim reads packet knots of its own assembly and its kinematic neighbours only (left arm: arm, hand, torso). same x mask with params.reads = bodies.g1\_simple.READS. Source: public morphology (bodies.g1\_simple).\par
\texttt{route.own\_assembly} [1.2.3] \ding{108}: system 0 (legged Realizer): a joint node reads only the packet knots of its own limb plus the body assembly. same x mask on assembly\_id, params.also\_key\_field = body (preset legged-s0). Source: public morphology (LeggedMorph).\par
\smallskip{\bfseries\scshape geometry}\par
\texttt{geo.above} [1.3.1] \ding{108}: above / below along gravity: +1 for tokens (and surface points) higher than the query by > 1 cm, -1 lower, 0 in the dead zone (query: middle cube of a stack). order x bias on pos3d, axis +z, margin 0.01 m (w=1). Source: tracker pos3d (given).\par
\texttt{geo.depth3d} [1.3.2] \ding{108}$\blacklozenge$: PaPE over (u, v, depth) in the declared front camera; weight on depth only, so tokens at the query's depth score high. sqdiff+diff x aug on cam\_uvd, a=(0,0,60), b=0 (learned). Source: projected tracker pos3d (given); default source = probe.\par
\texttt{geo.normal\_align} [1.3.3] $\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: query direction b vs each token's contact normal (arrows: outward normal, mean over the token's contacts). align x aug, world frame, b=(0,0,1) (learned per head). Source: gt contact\_normal (sim truth, training-only); deployed = probe.\par
\texttt{geo.orient} [1.3.4] $\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: relative rotation between token frames: tr(R\_i\^{}T R\_j) = 1 + 2 cos(angle) (axes: x red, y green, z blue). rel\_rot x aug, B = I (learned per head). Source: gt orient label (sim truth, training-only); deployed = probe estimate (object frames are not tracked).\par
\texttt{geo.pos3d} [1.3.5] \ding{108}: PaPE relative-position term: tokens near and below the gripper score high; heat = the term at every surface point. sqdiff+diff x aug, a=30, b=(0,0,-8), W\_p=I (learned per head). Source: public FK + tracker pos3d (given).\par
\smallskip{\bfseries\scshape kinematics / body}\par
\texttt{edge.foot\_of} [1.4.1] \ding{108}: a limb token attends to its own foot token (feet exist only on foot-carrying assemblies; limbs drawn at hips, feet at foot sites). edge x bias at ctx>ctx (legged-rel-v1; w=1). Source: public morphology (LeggedMorph).\par
\texttt{edge.limb\_adjacent} [1.4.2] \ding{108}: a limb token attends to the other limbs of the same kind on the trunk (all four legs; tokens drawn at their hips). edge x bias at ctx>ctx (legged-rel-v1, symmetric; w=1). Source: public morphology (LeggedMorph).\par
\texttt{edge.over\_cell} [1.4.3] \ding{108}: a foot token attends to the terrain-scan cells of its landing window (0.05 m behind to 0.35 m ahead, +-0.15 m aside of its default stance, body frame). edge x bias at ctx>ctx (legged-rel-v1; w=1). Source: public morphology + public terrain scan.\par
\texttt{edge.kin\_child} [1.4.4] \ding{108}: a command dim attends to its kinematic children (waist pitch -> both shoulder pitches). edge x bias at dims>dims (channel kin\_child; w=1). Source: public morphology (bodies.g1\_simple).\par
\texttt{edge.mirror} [1.4.5] \ding{108}: a command dim attends to its left/right homologue (grey lines: every mirror pair of the body). edge x bias at dims>dims (channel mirror; w=1). Source: public morphology (bodies.g1\_simple).\par
\texttt{edge.kin\_parent} [1.4.6] \ding{108}: a joint token attends to its kinematic parent joint (grey: every parent edge of the four legs). edge x bias at ctx>ctx (legged-rel-v1, from the per-assembly depth chain; w=1). Source: public morphology (LeggedMorph).\par
\texttt{kin.ancestor} [1.5.1] \ding{108}: a joint token attends to every joint up its kinematic chain (transitive closure of kin\_parent; grey arrows: the parent edges). ancestor (closure) x bias at ctx>ctx (arm-rel-v1; w=1). Source: public morphology (featurizer).\par
\texttt{kin.sibling} [1.5.2] \ding{108}: dims at undirected tree distance 2: the sibling (r\_shoulder\_pitch) and, by the same op, grandparent and grandchild. hop x bias over the symmetrized kin\_parent graph (hops=2; w=1). Source: public morphology (bodies.g1\_simple).\par
\smallskip{\bfseries\scshape physical interaction}\par
\texttt{ix.contact} [1.6.1] $\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: two entities in geometric contact (sim contact truth): query gripper $\to$ cube 1, distractors / target 0. White dots: the gripper--cube contact points. bilinear $\times$ aug (probe). Source: shown: gt label (training-only); deployed: estimated-probe.\par
\texttt{ix.force\_flow} [1.6.2] $\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: transitive closure of the support graph: everything the query carries, directly or through others. Bottom cube $\to$ middle 1 and top 1 (direct edge only to the middle). Op: flow (closure) over support-v1. flow $\times$ bias. Source: shown: closure of gt support (training-only); deployed: closure of the ix.support estimated-probe.\par
\texttt{ix.handover} [1.6.3] $\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: two manipulator assemblies in contact with the same object at once (a handover in progress): query L grip $\to$ R grip 1, bar / target 0. Dots: bar contacts of each hand. Dual env only. bilinear $\times$ aug (probe). Source: shown: gt label (training-only); deployed: estimated-probe.\par
\texttt{ix.held\_by} [1.6.4] $\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: object held by a manipulator assembly ($\geq$ 2 contacts with its hand bodies): lifted cube $\to$ gripper 1; target and distractors 0. bilinear $\times$ aug (probe). Source: shown: gt label (training-only); deployed: estimated-probe.\par
\texttt{ix.support} [1.6.5] $\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: a supports b: contact + contact normal within 30$^\circ$ of gravity-up at a's top. Query middle cube $\to$ top 1 (row); it is itself supported by the bottom cube (grey arrow, column). Emits the estimated support-v1 graph. bilinear $\times$ aug (probe, emits). Source: shown: gt label (training-only); deployed: estimated-probe.\par
\smallskip{\bfseries\scshape task / procedure}\par
\texttt{edge.actor\_of} [2.1.1] \ding{108}: manipulator entity $\leftrightarrow$ every event it is (cooperating) actor of; L grip acts in take, offer, release. Typed edge channel of the arm-rel-v1 graph, one learned weight per head. edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.consumed\_by} [2.1.2] \ding{108}: runtime receipt $\leftrightarrow$ the event whose output-binding role consumes it: offer.anchor is consumed by receive. edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.destination\_of} [2.1.3] \ding{108}: destination entity $\leftrightarrow$ event: the right gripper is where 'offer' and 'release' deliver the bar (target zone is place's destination). edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.enables} [2.1.4] \ding{108}: event $\to$ event it requires COMPLETED (requires\_completed): release needs receive and offer done. Public task-graph precedence. edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.maintained} [2.1.5] \ding{108}: event $\to$ event it requires ACTIVE (requires\_active): receive is only valid while offer is held. edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.node\_actor\_of} [2.1.6] \ding{108}: action node (one joint-command token) $\to$ every event its manipulator acts in: a 2-hop composition node $\to$ assembly $\to$ actor binding. Left-arm joint7 $\to$ take, offer, release. edge $\times$ bias (act>ctx). Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.output\_to} [2.2.1] \ding{108}: event $\leftrightarrow$ event consuming its output: receive's reference role binds offer's 'anchor' output (event\_output binding). edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.patient\_of} [2.2.2] \ding{108}: patient entity $\leftrightarrow$ the events that act on it: the bar is the patient of all five handover events (take, offer, receive, release, place). edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.pred\_arg} [2.2.3] \ding{108}: predicate-estimate token $\leftrightarrow$ its argument entities: held\_by(bar, left) points at the bar slot and the left-gripper assembly. edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.produced} [2.2.4] \ding{108}: runtime receipt $\leftrightarrow$ the event that produced it: the 'anchor' receipt (interact bank) was emitted by offer. edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.role\_in\_event} [2.2.5] \ding{108}: role-slot token $\leftrightarrow$ its event: receive owns four ordered role slots (actor, patient, source, reference); multiplicity is explicit. edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.role\_points\_to} [2.2.6] \ding{108}: role-slot token $\to$ the entity token it is bound to: receive:source $\to$ left-gripper assembly (an output binding points to no entity). edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{edge.support\_of} [2.3.1] \ding{108}: support-role entity $\leftrightarrow$ event: the left arm braces the fixture during align. ILLUSTRATIVE: no shipped arm/dual graph binds a support role to an entity; align:support rebound to 'left' (figure-only). edge $\times$ bias. Source: illustrative: public edge on a figure-only task-graph variant. \textsc{illustrative}.\par
\texttt{edge.target\_of} [2.3.2] \ding{108}: target entity (and every role without its own channel, here receive:source) $\leftrightarrow$ event: the left gripper is the source of 'receive'. edge $\times$ bias. Source: public (given): supplied task graph + runtime.\par
\texttt{task.next\_contact} [2.3.3] \ding{108}$\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: manipulator $\to$ graspable score, sharpened by the task gate (g\_task = 1.00 at init, learned). Dashed: PUBLIC candidate edges (1/|E|); solid: selected (gt reveal posterior given contact). bilinear $\times$ aug, gated. Source: candidates: public; selected: gt (training-only); deployed: estimated-probe $\times$ g\_task.\par
\smallskip{\bfseries\scshape locomotion}\par
\texttt{leg.com\_support} [2.4.1] $\blacktriangle$: readout of the stability margin: signed planar distance of the COM projection to the stance-foot support polygon (m, + inside). readout (inert), address assembly, gauss (1-d). Source: gt sim truth (contacts), training-only.\par
\texttt{leg.foothold} [2.4.2] $\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: pair label: each swinging foot -> the terrain-scan cell containing its next touchdown (hindsight); planted feet have no true pair. op bilinear, form aug (the bias IS the pair probe). Source: gt label (future touchdown), training-only; deployed = estimated-probe.\par
\smallskip{\bfseries\scshape UI}\par
\texttt{ui.above} [2.5.1] \ding{108}: signed render order: +1 if widget j is drawn above i (higher dense z-layer), -1 below, 0 same layer; dark = +1 (resize handles, shell), light = -1 (window frame, desktop icon). op order over field zlayer, form bias (antisymmetric). Source: public (given widget tree).\par
\texttt{ui.drag\_to} [2.5.2] $\blacktriangle$$\blacklozenge$: pair label: the teacher's drag handle -> the nearest widget outside the dragged window to where the drag ends (cw/drag\_window); 1 pair of 2116 valid. op bilinear, form aug (the bias IS the pair probe). Source: gt label (teacher goal), training-only; deployed = estimated-probe.\par
\texttt{ui.focus\_next} [2.5.3] \ding{108}: public UI edge: i, j consecutive in the tab order (focusable, enabled widgets in scene order, cyclic); Name -> Email. op edge, form bias (edges:ui-rel-v1 channel focus\_next). Source: public (given widget tree).\par
\texttt{ui.label\_for} [2.5.4] \ding{108}: public UI edge: a role=label widget -> the next widget after it in the same window (scene order); here 'Email' -> its textbox. op edge, form bias (edges:ui-rel-v1 channel label\_for). Source: public (given widget tree).\par
\texttt{ui.same\_window} [2.5.5] \ding{108}: 1 when two widgets belong to the same window (parent\_id equality; shell items such as the tab strip have parent -1 and never match). op same over field parent\_id, form bias. Source: public (given widget tree).\par
\smallskip{\bfseries\scshape probe readouts}\par
\texttt{probe.arm.acting\_on} [3.1.1] $\blacktriangle$: readout of whether assembly a's hand links touch entity e (contact truth). readout (inert), address entity x assembly, bce. Source: gt sim truth (Session.truth held\_by / contacts), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.arm.focused\_on} [3.1.2] \ding{108}: readout of which entities a currently ACTIVE task event binds (active op 'place': cube + target). readout (inert), address entity, bce. Source: public label (task runtime status + bindings).\par
\texttt{probe.arm.goal\_effect} [3.1.3] \ding{108}: readout of the displacement the task asks of each entity: destination minus patient for open events (cube -> target; others 0). readout (inert), address entity, gauss. Source: public label (task spec + public pose estimates).\par
\texttt{probe.arm.held\_by} [3.1.4] $\blacktriangle$: readout of whether entity e is held by assembly a (here gripper; cube 1, others 0). readout (inert), address entity x assembly, bce. Source: gt sim truth (Session.truth held\_by / contacts), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.arm.looking\_at} [3.1.5] $\blacktriangle$: readout of each entity's angle off the front-camera optical axis (gaze label, degrees, scaled 1/30). readout (inert), address entity, mse. Source: gt sim truth (camera pose + body pose), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.arm.observed\_effect} [3.1.6] $\blacktriangle$: readout of each entity's realized displacement over the 16-tick chunk (future\_disp; cube lifted, others 0). readout (inert), address entity, gauss. Source: gt sim truth (future state), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.arm.rel\_pos} [3.2.1] $\blacktriangle$: readout of entity position relative to the assembly's TCP, (x,y,z) m, world frame. readout (inert), address entity x assembly, gauss (mu, logvar). Source: gt sim truth, training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.arm.subtask} [3.2.2] \ding{108}: readout of the active task operator for the assembly (12-way; this episode: grasp -> place -> none). readout (inert), address assembly, ce. Source: public label (task runtime: first ACTIVE event's operator).\par
\texttt{probe.arm.visible} [3.2.3] $\blacktriangle$: readout of whether each entity is visible in the front camera (cube occluded by the closing gripper here: 0). readout (inert) on the packet, address entity, bce. Source: gt sim truth, training-only target; deployed = probe estimate.\par
\texttt{probe.legged.contact} [3.2.4] $\blacktriangle$: readout of each foot's ground contact at the 4 packet knots (+0.1/0.3/0.5/0.7 s) of a trot. readout (inert), address knot x assembly (feet), bce. Source: gt sim truth (future contacts), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.legged.disp} [3.2.5] $\blacktriangle$: readout of the base displacement over the next 0.8 s in the start body frame (xy in 0.5 m units, yaw change in rad). readout (inert), address assembly, gauss (3-d). Source: gt sim truth (future base pose), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.legged.fall} [3.2.6] $\blacktriangle$: readout of an imminent fall: 1 in the last 0.8 s of an episode that ends in a fall (non-foot ground contact, low base or tilt). readout (inert), address assembly, bce. Source: gt sim truth (episode outcome), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.legged.goal} [3.3.1] \ding{108}: readout of the active event's goal entity (here the waypoint) in the body yaw frame, /2 m, as the PUBLIC context estimates it. readout (inert), address assembly (body row), gauss (2-d). Source: public label (public context estimate).\par
\texttt{probe.legged.subtask} [3.3.2] \ding{108}: readout of which task event is active (walk\_to\_a, walk\_to\_b, halt, done) from the public task runtime. readout (inert), address assembly, ce. Source: public label (task runtime).\par
\texttt{probe.pointer.phase} [3.3.3] $\blacktriangle$: readout of the interaction phase of the commanded tick (idle, move, press, release, drag, type) at each knot. readout (inert), address knot x assembly, ce. Source: gt teacher command, training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.pointer.rel} [3.3.4] $\blacktriangle$: readout of the target point relative to the pointer, normalized screen units (x right, y up), per knot. readout (inert), address knot x assembly, gauss (2-d mean + logvar). Source: gt teacher target, training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.pointer.slot} [3.3.5] $\blacktriangle$: readout of WHICH widget the current plan step targets, as its stable slot index (opaque codes only, no widget content). readout (inert), address knot x assembly, ce over 80 slots. Source: gt teacher target, training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.psi0.active\_hand} [3.3.6] $\blacktriangle$: readout of which hand the packet binds to the target (here right); -1 (no contact ever) is masked. readout (inert), address body (per packet), ce over 2. Source: gt sim truth (future contacts), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.psi0.base\_cmd} [3.4.1] $\blacktriangle$: readout of the demonstrated base command at each knot (normalized action dims 32 = vx, 34 = turning flag per bodies.g1\_simple). readout (inert), address knot x pair (slot 0), gauss (2-d). Source: label from the recorded demonstration actions, training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.psi0.base\_disp} [3.4.2] $\blacktriangle$: readout of the pelvis displacement over the packet (t -> t+29) in the robot frame at t, plus yaw change. readout (inert), address body, gauss (3-d). Source: gt sim truth (pelvis pose), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.psi0.contact} [3.4.3] $\blacktriangle$: readout of hand-target contact per hand at the 5 knots (here the right hand closes on the target). readout (inert), address knot x pair, bce. Source: gt sim truth (recorded contacts), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.psi0.grasp\_face} [3.4.4] $\blacktriangle$: readout of the object face (+x,-x,+y,-y,+z,-z) of each hand's first contact. readout (inert), address knot x pair (last knot), ce over 6. Source: gt sim truth, training-only (default OFF). Illustrative: scene real, label value not computable here. \textsc{illustrative}.\par
\texttt{probe.psi0.grasp\_pt} [3.4.5] $\blacktriangle$: readout of each hand's FIRST contact point on the target in the object frame (last knot). readout (inert), address knot x pair (last knot), gauss (3-d). Source: gt sim truth, training-only (default OFF). Illustrative: scene real, label value not computable here. \textsc{illustrative}.\par
\texttt{probe.psi0.hand\_dist} [3.4.6] $\blacktriangle$: readout of each hand's palm-to-target distance at the 5 packet knots (+5..+29 ticks of 20 ms). readout (inert), address knot x pair (pair = L/R hand), gauss. Source: gt sim truth (recorded SIMPLE replay), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.psi0.lift} [3.5.1] $\blacktriangle$: readout of whether the target is lifted >= 3 cm above its initial height at each knot. readout (inert), address knot x pair (slot 0), bce. Source: gt sim truth (target pose), training-only.\par
\texttt{probe.psi0.target\_pos} [3.5.2] $\blacktriangle$: readout of the target's position at each knot in the robot (pelvis yaw) frame at t. readout (inert), address knot x pair (slot 0), gauss (3-d). Source: gt sim truth (target pose), training-only.\par
}
}
